title: Brassbound
description: The modpack for the Brassbound Server
body:
## A Minecraft 1.21.1 Neoforge modpack built for makers, tinkerers, and explorers.

**⚙️ Build & Automate**\
Harness the power of Create and a full suite of Create-addons to design intricate machines, moving contraptions, and fully automated factories.

**🎨 Shape Your World**\
Bring your imagination to life with Chisel & Bits, Chipped, and other decoration mods for endless creative expression.

**🍲 Live & Thrive**\
Enjoy immersive gameplay with Farmer’s Delight, Simply Swords, Carry On, and a collection of quality-of-life mods that make adventuring and building smoother than ever.

**🏰 Join the Community**

Brassbound isn’t just a modpack—it’s a friendly, collaborative whitelisted server where players share projects, trade ideas, and build together.

- Download the pack
- Apply through [Discord](https://discord.gg/AaZUYyjR4c)
- Start crafting your masterpiece

Come create something extraordinary with us—your next big build starts in Brassbound!
